text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. The main benefit of all this testing is confidence. When tests pass, developers feel safe making changes, because they know the tests will catch mistakes. Without testing, even small updates can become risky and stressful.
